description: Use this when the user wants an account's per-post metrics (views, likes, comments, shares, engagement) over the last N posts or days, for a performance review or to compare accounts on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook. Credit cost depends on platform and post count. Longer runs return a `job_id` for xcut_get_job. Do not use to find standout posts (use xcut_find_outliers).

canvas_id.description: Canvas (UUID) that owns the thumbnails. Optional. The table is returned here, not placed on the canvas.
canvas_id.title: Canvas Id

days.description: Or: posts from the last N days.
days.title: Days
